name: KEEP-WALLET-the-wallets-guard-gone
why: The wallet, the Deadlands Ember and the Welkynd Shard are each bound by their template rows (walletItem.js WALLET_ROW, gateSpoils.js), so the trade's own refusal below already keeps them; the guard is the owner's rule written where the zone's law is read, and holds should a row ever lose its binding. The pin holds the outcome either way.
